verification.notes: Verified against locally installed claude 2.1.319. Accepts --model <model> in both interactive and non-interactive modes (-p / --print). Claude Code supports Anthropic models and Amazon Bedrock provided models (e.g. 'anthropic.claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022-v2:0', 'us.anthropic.claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022-v2:0', 'anthropic.claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219-v1:0', 'sonnet', 'opus', 'haiku') with AWS credentials or CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK=1. River AI models belong exclusively to Kilo Code.

model_passing.notes: Accepts Anthropic model aliases (e.g. 'sonnet', 'opus') or Amazon Bedrock model IDs (e.g. 'anthropic.claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022-v2:0', 'us.anthropic.claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022-v2:0').

non_interactive.notes: Verified via `claude --help`: `-p, --print` prints response and exits for non-interactive output.
